definitionZh: 字体变异设置 CSS 属性通过让您指定您想要随其值变化的特性的四个字母轴名称,为可变字体特性提供低级控制.
sourceDefinition: The font-variation-settings CSS property provides low-level control over variable font characteristics by letting you specify the four letter axis names of the characteristics you want to vary along with their values.
